{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
# We'll also check if biomarker_final has any sentinel values
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check if any biomarker_final values are -999.0
print('Number of rows with biomarker_final == -999.0:', (filtered_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Now compute treatment response as change in biomarker levels
filtered_df['treatment_response'] = filtered_df['biomarker_final'] - filtered_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check sex distribution
print('\nSex distribution in filtered data:')
print(filtered_df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check for missing sex
print('\nMissing sex values:', filtered_df['sex'].isnull().sum())

# Now compute average treatment response by sex
male_response = filtered_df[filtered_df['sex'] == 'M']['treatment_response'].mean()
female_response = filtered_df[filtered_df['sex'] == 'F']['treatment_response'].mean()

difference = female_response - male_response

print(f'\nAverage treatment response (male): {male_response:.2f}')
print(f'Average treatment response (female): {female_response:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (female - male): {difference:.2f}')"}
